metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity of up to 2048 nonpadding item embeddings sampled with seed 42, mapped by (cosine+1)/2. Zero vectors use torch normalization semantics. This measures embedding alignment, not recommendation diversity, user preference, or ranking quality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_sample_count: Number of sampled item embedding rows, excluding padding.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_undefined_reason: Reason alignment is null, or null when defined.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean raw neural positive-minus-loader-negative logit over finite valid positions in the first ten batches. Features use only sequence through the source position, preserving its positional indices. In-sample training diagnostic; excludes transition and popularity residuals.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank empirical 10th percentile of those same neural margins.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of those neural margins strictly below zero; ties are excluded.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of those neural margins below 0.5. This threshold depends on logit scale and cannot certify ranking quality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Includes queried, finite and nonfinite position counts, and counts of margins below 0.5 and zero. Valid positions require nonzero source, positive and negative IDs. Undefined margin statistics are null with a reason. Category lists remain empty because categories are unavailable. prefix_suffix_audit checks at most one valid query per batch by comparing explicit-prefix features and neural scores against the same position with a changed appended suffix. Finite comparisons use rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5; nonfinite queries are reported separately. Zero audited queries are undefined, not a passed check. This bounded audit cannot prove causality for every possible input and does not measure fused score invariance.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:fused_training_ranking: Unavailable here. A valid fused diagnostic requires actual prefix histories, frozen training-derived scales, and subtraction of one queried adjacent occurrence from its pair count, source total, target frequency and frequency total, recomputing all affected probabilities. Such subtraction would not make neural scores out-of-sample.
